label: SYNTHETIC toy inputs for the numerical check of the LO Drell-Yan Jacobian (theory:drell-yan-lo). The densities are invented Beta forms, not fits; both hadrons use the same toy set; the numbers are not a statement about any hadron or collision.
density_form: number density f(x) = sum_k N_k x^a_k (1 - x)^b_k, entries [N_k, a_k, b_k]
units: integrated cross sections in units of (4 pi alpha^2 / 3) GeV^-2 (no value of alpha is used); multiply by 86.8 nb GeV^2 (PDG Eq. 51.3) for nb
